University of Florida

Sponsorship outreach, in four steps.

Strike Magazine GNV is UF's student-run fashion and culture magazine. We sell ad space to local Gainesville businesses. Everyone on the Finance Team sends from their own email. There is no shared Strike inbox.

  1. Pick a business

    Open Prospects, choose someone Not Contacted, and check Tracking so nobody else has them.

  2. Personalize the email

    Open the business, click Draft with Claude, then replace every [bracket] — including [Your name].

  3. Send it

    Send from your own email. Sign: Finance Team, Strike Magazine GNV, Instagram: @strikemagazinegnv

  4. Log it

    In Tracking, set Status to Contacted and add the date. Two people should never email the same shop.

Hard rules

  • No chains or franchises. Local, independent businesses only.
  • No alcohol, tobacco, or vape ads.
  • No sexual or inappropriate brands.
  • Strike is not a nonprofit.

Quarter page $50 · Half page $100 · Full page $200 Tabling at parties and events by request (no set price) 11.5K Instagram followers · @strikemagazinegnv

Copy, fill in the brackets, send

Email templates

Replace everything in [brackets]. Attach the Sponsorship Guide unless the template says not to. Send from your own email.

1. First email

Use for every new business. Attach the Strike Sponsorship Guide PDF.

Subject: [Business name] x Strike Magazine GNV Ad Proposal

Hi [Business name team or contact name], I hope you're doing well! My name is [your name], and I'm on the finance team at Strike Magazine GNV, the University of Florida's student-run fashion and culture magazine. Each semester our student team puts together a new issue covering fashion, music and pop culture, and our Instagram community is 11.5K followers strong. [Say why you picked them: something you like about their business, or why their customers match our readers.] We're currently booking ad spots in this semester's issue. Our rates are: - Quarter page: $50 - Half page: $100 - Full page: $200 I've attached our sponsorship guide with more details. If you're interested, just reply with the ad size you'd like, or let us know if you have any questions. We'd also be happy to talk about tabling at one of our parties or events. Stay on the thread

Follow-up guide

Day 0

Send the first email. Log Status as Contacted and enter Date Contacted.

Day 7

If there is no reply, send Follow-up 1 on the same email thread.

Day 14

If there is still no reply, send Follow-up 2 (the last note).

After that

Mark Status as No Response. Do not keep chasing.

What each status means

  • Not Contacted Nobody on the team has reached out yet. Safe to pick up.
  • Contacted A first message went out. Wait 7 days before following up.
  • Replied They wrote back. Keep the conversation going until they decide.
  • Confirmed They said yes. Record ad size. The finance director invoices.
  • Declined They said no. Leave them alone this issue.
  • No Response Two follow-ups, still silence. Stop for this issue.

One live sheet for the whole team

Tracking

Log every email you send here so two people never contact the same business. Record status, date contacted, ad size, and payment.
